t: A free spreadsheet app that runs entirely in the browser: enter values and formulas, format cells, and calculate results instantly with no installation or account.
A grid of cells for storing data and formulas

This app provides a grid of cells for storing data and formulas and calculating results in the browser. You can enter numbers, text, dates, and formulas, format cells, copy and paste ranges, undo and redo, and import and export CSV files. Everything runs locally with no network connection, and results update automatically when referenced cells change. Use the formula bar to edit, the formatting tools to adjust the look, and the keyboard to navigate quickly.
Yes, everything runs in the browser with no server or account needed.
What data types can I enter?
Numbers, text, dates, Boolean values, and formulas starting with an equals sign.
How do I sum a range of cells?
Use a formula like =SUM(A1:A10) in the formula bar.
Yes, choose a file using the Import button and the cells will be filled from the selected position.
Does it support undo and redo?
Yes, every change is saved in the history and can be undone or redone.
